tweet.text:
4. Anyone can initialize your pool before you do.

Launchpads graduate into a pool anyone can predict:
Attacker initializes it at a wrong price → adds dust liquidity → graduation fails → no market

Cost: a few thousand wei.

Gate `beforeInitialize`, or assume the pool exists.
